component.name: HDMI Captain
component.summary: Low-latency viewer for USB HDMI capture cards

description.p: HDMI Captain shows a USB HDMI capture card with its sound and keeps it running: it never stops for focus or workspace changes and reconnects by itself when the card or the source drops out.

ul.li: Fit, fill, stretch and pixel-perfect scaling, colour range and matrix, picture looks and .cube LUTs
Guides, scopes, test patterns and a diagnostics overlay
Several cards at once, in their own windows or a grid
Screenshots straight from the source, without any on-screen controls

description.p: Recording and Save Recent are a one-time Pro unlock bought on our website; everything else is free.
